summary: std/http: one HTTP/2 connection buffers unfinished request bodies of at most four times XO_HTTP_MAX_BODY together
details: one HTTP/2 connection buffers unfinished request bodies of at most four times XO_HTTP_MAX_BODY together; the stream that would pass it is refused with REFUSED_STREAM, which a client may retry. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/http, native backends): one HTTP/2 connection buffers unfinished request bodies of at most four times XO_HTTP_MAX_BODY together; the stream that would pass it is refused with REFUSED_STREAM, which a client may retry. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
